problem_statement: Build a brand-new /archive page from scratch on the Charca astro-blog-template site. The route /archive does not exist yet (baseline 404/empty). Construct a full blog Archive page that lists every post grouped by publication year, and add an interactive year filter: a row of year buttons (All + one per year) that shows/hides the year groups and updates a status line reporting how many posts are visible. The page MUST reuse the site's existing design system for cross-page consistency — wrap it in the shared BaseLayout so it inherits the same Header/Nav (home / about / blog links + theme toggle) and Footer (Powered by Astro / Template by Maxi Ferreira), and use the site's theme tokens (--primary-color #548e9b, --font-family-serif Merriweather body, --font-family-sans Fira Sans headings/nav). The new page must look and feel like a sibling of the existing about/blog pages.
required_content: A lede paragraph starting 'Browse every post ever published...'
A year-filter button row: an 'All' button plus one button per year (2023, 2022, 2021), styled with the site's --primary-color pill accent
A live status paragraph 'Showing all N posts in the archive.' that updates when a year is selected
One <section> per year, each headed by an <h2> of the year (primary-color underline accent) containing that year's posts
Each post = <h3> title linking to /blog/<slug>, an excerpt paragraph, and an uppercase date span
Shared chrome via BaseLayout: Header/Nav (home/about/blog + theme toggle) and Footer (Powered by Astro / Maxi Ferreira)
design_constraints: Reuse BaseLayout (shared Header/Nav + Footer) — do NOT hand-roll a separate <html>/nav/footer
Use CSS custom properties from global.css: --primary-color #548e9b for accents, --text-secondary for muted text, --font-family-sans for headings/nav/labels, --font-family-serif for body
current="blog" so the Blog nav item is marked selected (archive is part of the blog section)
Inline the post data as a static array (no live API / getCollection fetch) so the page renders deterministically
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /archive (仅空 stub 保证 SSG 不 fallback 到 index.html); reference 完整实现 (BaseLayout 复用 + 年份过滤交互); bad = reference 但过滤按钮未接线 (点击无效) → 只失 interaction gate, 其余全过 (共享 chrome/palette/mobile 与 reference 一致)。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。T3 差异化 = 跨页一致性: /archive 复用 sibling 页的 Header/Nav/Footer + theme tokens。
